name: Elementalist
blurb: Fire, frost and thunder. Every slot adds another element to the storm.

name: Arcane Battery
blurb: Casts echo and overload. Rewards not getting hit.

name: Summoner
blurb: Familiars and wards fight for you while you keep your distance.

name: Bladeguard
blurb: Piercing swords and a defensive backbone.

name: Vanguard
blurb: Momentum. Drive into the crowd and knock it apart.

name: Executioner
blurb: Crits and executes. Melts elites, struggles against a wall.

name: Forgemaster
blurb: Returning axe, fire pools and explosives.

name: Prospector
blurb: Greed build. Gems fuel your armour and your bombs.

name: Emplacement
blurb: Plant turrets and hold ground. Slow, immovable, lethal.

name: Radiance
blurb: Orbiting censers, holy strikes and steady healing.

name: Inquisitor
blurb: Burn and judgement. Trades safety for damage.

name: Shepherd
blurb: Shields and denial. The crowd simply cannot reach you.
